title: Entity scope catalogue
description: Cross-service registry mapping JPA entities to data-scope tipos. Source of truth for: (a) @FilterDef + @Filter emission by be-entity-generator; (b) the if/elif branches in DataScopeFilterAspect (which filters to enable for each scope tipo). The tipo strings MUST match rbac.arch.json data_scope.types[*].id (validated by cross_validate_entity_scope_against_rbac). D-062.

$comment.description: Free-text note for maintainers; not consumed by any generator.

scopes.description: Keyed by data-scope tipo (must exist in rbac.data_scope.types). Value is the list of entities subject to that scope.

entity.description: PascalCase JPA entity class name without the trailing 'Entity' suffix (e.g. 'Venda' for VendaEntity).

table.description: Underlying snake_case table name. The entity generator matches by table_name parsed from the DDL.

filter_name.description: Hibernate filter identifier emitted as @FilterDef(name) on the entity AND enableFilter(name) in the aspect. Per-entity scope avoids duplicate FilterDef across entities with different columns.

column.description: Column on the entity table the filter restricts (e.g. 'vendedor_id').

param.description: Filter parameter identifier used in @ParamDef + setParameter (e.g. 'vendedorId'). camelCase, matches HQL convention.

kind.description: scalar: emits 'column = :param' / setParameter. list: emits 'column IN (:param)' / setParameterList. Mirrors rbac.data_scope.types[*].value_kind (uuid vs csv-uuid).
